portfolio.title: VidGrep
portfolio.description: Multimodal RAG system that searches YouTube videos by both on-screen content and spoken audio, returning timestamped moments with auto-seeking playback. Built with Python, Streamlit, Ollama (Moondream), LangChain, ChromaDB, and FFmpeg.

portfolio.title: WATWINGS
portfolio.description: 2,900-line zero-dependency 3D flight simulator streaming a live 1:1 photogrammetry mesh of Waterloo via Google's Photorealistic 3D Tiles API. Features 6-DOF flight physics, raycast collision, HUD with off-screen target indicators, and a Web Audio engine with zero audio asset files.

portfolio.title: Backgammon Game
portfolio.description: Java implementation of the classic board game Backgammon with an AI opponent, made using OOP with UX/QoL considerations and complex game mechanics.

portfolio.title: lawrencewang.site
portfolio.description: React + Sass portfolio showcasing API-driven features: REST integrations, OAuth, resumable uploads with CORS handling, lazy loading, accessible UX, and optional Firebase persistence
